params.body:
The link to the worksheet app under the sign-in form asked "Arbeider? Ga naar de werf-app." It is not only for labourers: drivers, site leads and anybody else who records a day use it too. It now reads **Klik hier voor de werf-app**, same link, same place.

One line in `resources/views/livewire/office/login.blade.php`. OfficeAccessTest passes.
params.title: Sign-in page: 'Klik hier voor de werf-app'
